label: Partygoer
note: A dancer on a party barge (src/systems/world/party_barge.gd) once you hurt anyone on board: swapped where they stand for this body, wearing their own look (the barge sets 'archetype'), holdout pistol out, run by the barge's own Townsfolk with standing off.
